entities.summary: Tsey Jawdat Said was a Syrian-Circassian Sunni Islamic scholar who belonged to the School of the famous Islamic thinkers professor Malek Bennabi and Muhammad Iqbal. He was called the Arab Gandhi for his pacifistic opinions.
